title: Missing number
summary: Return the one number between 0 and nums.length that does not appear in `nums`.
hints: If nothing were missing, which numbers would be present? How does the actual list differ from that complete list?
You know exactly which numbers should be there: 0 through n. Compare a property of the complete set with the same property of the array.
Add up 0 through n, subtract the sum of the array, and what remains is the missing number. A set of the values, checked from 0 to n, also works.
takeaway: The sum trick is O(n) time with no extra memory. In Java, C# and C, check that the total fits in an int before trusting it: n * (n + 1) overflows once n passes about 46,000.
